decisions.decision: The board signed the accounts payable warrant ($681,570.09) and the payroll deductions and payroll warrants ($975,455.36 each), with no vote recorded.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Colonial Power Group reported the town's aggregation rate rises by $0.00128 per kWh from the May 2023 meter reads, fixed through November 2024.
budget_items.quote: the new rate (increasing from $0.11740 per kwh to $0.11868 per kwh) will be fixed through the remainder of the term, ending november 2024.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: At average usage of 600 kWh per month, the aggregation increase was stated as $0.77 per month per customer.
budget_items.quote: given the average usage of 600 kwh per month, the new aggregation rate represents an increase of $0.77 per month versus the current rate per customer.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: If the $5.2 M renovation were fully debt-funded by the town, it would be 1.68% of the levy under the 4% net regular debt cap and 1.53% of total levy under the 14% aggregate debt service cap; the minutes say ARPA and grants would lower these.
budget_items.quote: if the marshall park renovation construction is fully debt funded by the town, $5.2 m, it would represent 1.68% of the levy

budget_items.topic: Marshall Park design costs to date
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conceptual design paid ($36,000) and property survey (about $18,000) completed; schematic design costing $45,000 has begun and a next phase estimate of 50 000 was given.
budget_items.quote: the schematic design, costing $45,000, has just begun and was funded at the last town meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Phase cost figures were presented: phase 1 about $3.3 million, phase 2 $1.5 million in narrative but $1.48 million on the slide, phase 3 $270,000 and phase 4 $86,000.
budget_items.quote: the first phase would be cost about $3.3 million and that's the bulk of the construction

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Uncommitted ARPA funds were stated as $2.3 million; ARPA must be committed by December 31, 2024 and spent by December 31, 2026.
Grant programs listed with maximum amounts for the Marshall Park project, including LWCF, PARC, AARP, MAAB, MassTrails and Stanton Foundation.
budget_items.quote: parkland acquisitions & renovations for communities (parc) grant- june 2023-up to $400k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Prior FY21 low bid for the carport reconfiguration was $298,750 and the Town Manager said it came in at almost $300 000; the project is being rebid and $135,000 is budgeted.
budget_items.quote: when bid in fy21 low bid was $298,750. decided to hold off due to market.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY2005-FY21 capital projects total appropriation and remaining balance, with unexpended capital of $14,951.93 to be reappropriated.
One bid received on 2/23/23 for approximately $300K for Town Hall repairs; project on hold pending reassessment.

budget_items.quote: conceptual design complete; $13,377 left from phase 1 will be used on schematic
